Thanks, I've saved that. The old memory said releases were done by pushing a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag by hand. I've replaced it with a new one saying releases now go through `make release`, which tags and publishes.

There's no `release` target yet in the `Makefile` on `main`, which only has `test` and `test-fast`. If it's on a branch that hasn't merged, that's fine. I noted this in the new memory so the target gets checked before anyone relies on it, and the memory is set to be re-checked when the `Makefile` changes.
